title: Threat Level Midnight
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Threat Level Midnight,' Michael creates and screens a movie featuring action scenes, a villain named Goldenface, and a hockey storyline. The episode includes scenes of confrontation, humor, and chaos related to the movie's plot, with characters reacting to and discussing the film. The episode also features a staged shootout and a hockey game, blending parody and comedy.
